actions.title: Add the sub(-1, -1) test for sub(a, b) (UC-1)
actions.body:
Answers the Reviewer's finding on this pull request (head 202c55a).

**Finding 1: the sub(-1, -1) test.** Added in test/sub.test.js as its own test, `subtracts a negative number from a negative one (UC-1)`, asserting `sub(-1, -1) === 0` with `assert.strictEqual`, the same pattern as the other three tests. This is the test the repository's rule keeps out of a first pull request until a review asks for it. No source file changed: src/sub.js already returns a - b.

**Tests.** `run_gate` (node --test) passes: 5 tests, 0 failing. The new test passes against the existing src/sub.js, so it is a check of behaviour already in place, not a test written first.

**For the owner.** UC-1's Tests column should list test/sub.test.js. The Implementation section of the decision records is unchanged; no decision record applies to this change beyond what UC-1 already traces to.

The pull request follows UC-1. It changes no decision record and no use-case file.
